css: .sensei-c { left:920px; width:860px; box-sizing:border-box; padding:20px 28px } .sensei-c h4 { margin:0; font-size:24px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.1em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--mute) } .sensei-score { position:absolute; right:28px; top:10px; font-family:var(--display,serif); font-size:52px; color:var(--jade) } .sensei-pills { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:12px; margin-top:16px } .sensei-pills span { padding:9px 18px; border-radius:999px; font-size:24px; font-weight:500; background:var(--ground); border:2px solid var(--hair); white-space:nowrap } .sensei-pills span.ok { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--jade) 16%, var(--tile)); border-color:var(--jade) } .sensei-pills span.no { border-color:var(--accent); color:var(--accent); border-style:dashed } .sensei-flag { position:absolute; right:22px; top:14px; transform:none } .sensei-rrow { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:18px; margin-top:20px } .sensei-b { padding:14px 22px; border-radius:20px; border-bottom-right-radius:6px; background:var(--main); color:var(--ground); font-size:26px; white-space:nowrap } .sensei-arrow { font-size:34px; color:var(--jade); font-weight:600 } .sensei-rule { box-sizing:border-box; padding:12px 20px; border-radius:14px; background:var(--tile); border:3px solid var(--jade); font-size:25px; line-height:1.3; white-space:nowrap } .sensei-rule small { display:block; font-size:20px; color:var(--mute) }
